305 | #### dbt templater tests
306 | 
307 | The dbt templater tests require a locally running Postgres instance. See the
308 | required connection parameters in `plugins/sqlfluff-templater-dbt/test/fixtures/dbt/profiles.yml`.
309 | We recommend using https://postgresapp.com/.
310 | 
311 | To run the dbt-related tests you will have to explicitly include these tests:
312 | 
313 | ```shell
314 | tox -e cov-init,dbt019-py310,cov-report-dbt -- plugins/sqlfluff-templater-dbt
315 | ```
316 | 
317 | For more information on adding and running test cases see the [Parser Test README](test/fixtures/dialects/README.md) and the [Rules Test README](test/fixtures/rules/std_rule_cases/README.md).
318 | 
319 | #### Running dbt templater tests in Docker
320 | 
321 | The development Docker container has the dbt templater plugin installed,
322 | so you can run the tests inside the container. Inside the container, run:
323 | ```
324 | pytest -v plugins/sqlfluff-templater-dbt/test/
325 | ```
